architecture.summary: Add guidance for a manually authored T2 architecture comparison comment. The guidance defines merge-base and stacked-PR baselines, change colors and text labels, sequence handling, commit revision evidence, renderer checks, and manager review. This adds a human-readable review artifact requirement. It adds no automated gate and changes no human approval authority or test and metrics authority. No application source or runtime configuration changes. The context, container, component, runtime, and deployment views in architecture/components.md remain accurate because the guidance changes only the review workflow, not application boundaries, contracts, collaborations, runtime order, resource ownership, or deployment. No registry edit is needed.
